segments.text: This is GitHub trending today number 14 and I've handpicked 27 trending open- source projects that are blowing up right now. Let's get started.
Talk is a command line time tracking tool built for developers who live in the terminal. It logs your work in simple human readable plain text files
so your data stays portable and futurep proof.
You also get a beautiful interactive TUI complete with a calendar view powered by bubble t built in go with clean
architecture. It's fast and ships as a single binary with zero dependencies.
Claudis is a WhatsApp and Telegram gateway for AI agents, letting you trigger actions on your own machine just
by sending a message. It bridges WhatsApp web and Telegram bots to a local coding agent, making it perfect for setups like claude code running from
your pocket. You get group chat support, media handling, and even a dedicated browser profile for screenshots and automation.
What if you could talk to every top AI model at the same time on your Mac? This is Chorus, an open- source desktop app
that lets you chat with chat GPT, Claude, Gemini, and local models side by side in one place. No more guessing
which model is right. Chorus shows you all their answers at once. Chorus can see what's on your screen so the models understand what you're working on. No explaining, no context switching.
This project brings the Windows 11 clipboard history experience straight to Linux, and it's surprisingly polished.
It works on both Wayland and X11 using low-level input handling to bypass the usual Wayland limitations. Hit SuperV
and your clipboard pops up instantly right where your mouse is, even across multiple monitors. You get pinning, rich
media support, and a built-in emoji picker. Perfect for chat apps and dev workflows.
Mac USB makes creating bootable Mac OS and OSX USB installers ridiculously easy, especially on Apple Silicon Macs.
If you've ever hit terminal errors, expired certificates, or broken installers while trying to revive an older Intel Mac, this tool fixes that.
It's a one-click app that detects the Mac OS version, formats the USB drive, and builds the installer automatically.
If you support legacy Macs, this is a lifesaver.
Stop doom scrolling through a 100page SEC filings. This is Tank. Talk to 10Ks and 10 Q's with AI. Instead of reading
filings line by line, you just ask questions in plain English, and Tank answers with real citations linked straight to the source. No
hallucinations, no guessing. It autofetches filings from the SEC, indexes them locally with Rag, and lets
you query across multiple reports instantly.
Proxy Checker Pro is a professional-grade proxy testing tool with a clean guey. It supports HTTP and SOCK 5 proxies, including full username
and password authentication. You can load proxies in almost any format, test them in real time, and even measure actual download speed. It automatically
detects proxy location and lets you verify proxies using HTTP requests or raw socket checks.
Stepify is a self-hosted STL tostep converter built for makers and 3D printing enthusiasts.
If you've ever downloaded an STL and struggled to edit it in Fusion 360 or Frecad, this solves that problem. You
get a drag and drop web interface with a real-time 3D preview so you can inspect meshes before converting. Stepify automatically repairs broken meshes.
Lets you tune conversion tolerance to MCP lets you turn any website or documentation into an MCP server
instantly. Just add tomcp.org before any URL and your docs become structured AI ready context. Instead of dumping noisy
HTML into prompts to MCP cleans pages into readable markdown using far fewer tokens. The real win persistent MCP
resources. Documentation stays pinned as trusted readonly context, dramatically reducing hallucinations.
LMW walk lets you explore the full answer space of a prompt. It branches across the most likely tokens, then ranks complete answers by probability.
The tree is walked intelligently, stopping as soon as it's guaranteed to have the top end most likely outputs. It works with MLX supported open models,
runs straight from the CLI, and gives you deep insight into what an LLM almost said, but didn't.
Page Flow is a minimal Mac OS PDF viewer built for speed. It's written in Swift UI with PDF Kit, so everything feels
fast and perfectly Mac native. You get annotations, bookmarks, and powerful text search without clutter or bloat.
Switch between single page or two-up views, depending on how you read. It updates automatically, works fully offline, and collects zero telemetry.
In UI is a liquid glass component library you can preview, copy, and drop straight into your web apps. It delivers a polished frosted glass aesthetic,
fully accessible, and responsive out of the box. Components are distributed via the Shad CN registry, so installing them into existing projects is effortless.
There's a full documentation and preview site, plus ready-made page templates like admin dashboards.
Need to remove image backgrounds instantly without uploading your photos anywhere? Meet Cut It Out, an open- source AI background remover that runs
entirely in your browser. Cut it out uses the powerful UWNet deep learning model running via web assembly and onx, so your images never leave your device.
And it's not just one-click magic. You get prolevel editing tools, plus zoom and pan for pixel perfect control.
Export full resolution transparent PGs.
Gemini desktop for Mac OS is a lightweight unofficial desktop wrapper for Google Gemini. It gives you a native Mac OS experience while simply loading the official Gemini web interface.
Nothing scraped, nothing modified. The standout feature is a floating chat bar that stays on top of your apps. With a
global keyboard shortcut you can trigger from anywhere.
Skuit is like lazy git but for SQL databases. A lightweight terminal UI that gets you querying Postgress, MySQL,
SQL Server and more in seconds. It comes with a connection manager so you can save connections and switch databases without juggling CLI arguments. Out of
the box, it supports multiple databases, has built-in SSH tunnels, Vim style modal editing, and query history per connection.
Shout is a lightweight speechtoext tool for Wayland and Hyperland. Hit a key to start recording. Hit it again to
transcribe and press enter. It's that simple. It's designed to be fast and unobtrusive. Perfect for quickly turning
speech into text without leaving your workflow. Works especially well with AI coding agents like Clawed Code where
transcription doesn't have to be perfect to be useful.
Demandox is a lightweight web-based markdown documentation browser that keeps your files organized and easy to
navigate. It scans multiple directories, automatically extracts overviews from overview sections, and presents
everything in a clean, responsive web interface.
Deployment is a breeze. A single binary with embedded templates and a simple config file.
Markdown Site is a markdown powered website built with React, perfect for blogs. Write posts in markdown. Run a
single sync command and your content appears live instantly with real-time updates across all browsers thanks to Convex. It supports syntax highlighted
code blocks, four themes, responsive design, and real-time analytics.
Universal Reddit scraper suite is a fullfeatured Reddit scraping and analytics platform and it doesn't require any API keys. Scrape posts,
comments, images, videos, and galleries, and visualize everything on a beautiful streamllet dashboard with multiple tabs.
Keep track of job history, durations, and errors. Run dry tests, export data to parquet, and schedule scrapes with cron style jobs.
PDF sign is a lightweight PDF signing tool written in Rust that supports open PGP and SIG store signatures. It appends
cryptographic signatures directly to PDFs, keeping your documents authentic, tamperproof, and fully compatible with
standard PDF readers. For casual users, you can sign PDFs with your Google, Microsoft, or GitHub account. No keys to manage.
Cientre is a training free GPU free spatial prompting framework for MLMs. It enhances spatial reasoning by combining
semanticrich keyframe extraction with camera trajectory reconstruction via visual odometry, giving your models
explicit motion cues. No fine-tuning or architecture changes are needed. A single forward pass injects structured
spatial temporal prior directly into the model.
CSVX Editor is a web-based spreadsheet tool built for the CSVX format, an enhanced CSV that adds rich formatting
metadata while staying compatible with standard CSV readers. It gives you full control over cell formatting, colors,
gradients, text styles, alignment, wrapping, and borders, all visually previewed in the editor. Edit single or multiple cells at once and handle large data sets efficiently with lazy loading.
Mention networkbot is a multi-threaded automation tool for mention network powered by AI models like Google Gemini.
It generates organic contextaware conversations, manages daily quests, and optimizes point farming efficiency
across multiple accounts. The bot features a smart persona system to create unique AI personalities, multi-threaded operation for simultaneous accounts.
PDF Brain is a local PDF knowledge base with semantic vector search, letting you extract, embed, and search your documents intelligently. It's local
first, so everything runs on your machine with no API costs. Search your PDFs using vector embeddings via's MX by
embed large or combine it with full text search for a hybrid approach.
Life Tracker plug-in transforms Obsidian into a personal data visualization hub, letting you capture and visualize the
data that matters most in your life. It offers 12 chart types from heat maps and line charts to PI radar and even tag
clouds. All interactive and animated charts support GitHub style heat maps, tool tips, clickable elements that open
source notes, and configurable color schemes.
Spider is a physics-based retargeting framework that maps human motions to a wide range of robotic embodiment from
dexterous hands to full humanoids. It's the first general purpose pipeline supporting multiple robots and data sets
out of the box with seamless integration into reinforcement learning and behavior cloning workflows. Spider works natively
with multiple simulators like Mujoko Rap and Genesis.
Metal Goose is a GPU accelerated upscaling and frame generation tool for Mac OS. It delivers smooth high FPS
performance for games and apps similar to Nvidia DLSS or AMD FSR but optimized for Mac OS with MGUP 1 upscaling. Choose
from performance balanced or quality modes and multiple render scales enhanced by contrast adaptive sharpening.
